evidence_items.title: zyh200727/PSVU-Bench
evidence_items.summary: PSVU-Bench PSVU-Bench is the benchmark for Personalized Streaming Video Understanding (PSVU), introduced in PEARL: Personalized Streaming Video Understanding with Runtime-Defined Concepts. In PSVU a model watches a video stream, a user defines new concepts (characters, objects or actions) at any timestamp, and later asks questions about these concepts in the present scene or about their past.
